items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Could Be 29% Undervalued Following Its KFC Deal Renewal
items.summary: PepsiCo (PEP) just renewed its beverage supply deal with KFC across eight international markets, extending a decades long partnership and keeping its drink portfolio embedded in one of the largest global fast food chains. PepsiCo shares have picked up speed recently, with a 30 day share price return of 13.52% and a 7 day move of 6.67% at a last close of US$142.71. This comes even though the 3 year total shareholder return declined 4.29% and the 5 year total shareholder return was 3.16%...

items.title: PepsiCo Extends KFC Beverage Partnership Across Eight International Markets
items.summary: PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) has renewed its beverage supply agreement with KFC across eight international markets, extending a longstanding commercial relationship between the food and beverage companies. The agreement covers Australia, India, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium.

items.title: Celsius Holdings earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Celsius Holdings Inc (CELH) beat on both lines, yet the stock gave back its premarket pop. Shares were $30.02 (-2.39%) as of Nov 5, 1:24 PM EST. They had opened at $32.84 and traded as high as $33.69. Premarket had been up roughly 5–10%. The market is separating "beat" from "fixed."

items.title: Energy-Drinks Are Exploding. Why Is Celsius Stock Fizzling?
items.summary: The energy-drink industry is growing sales at 15% a year, the fastest in the beverage aisle. But competition is fierce, with each brand staking a claim to niche consumers.
